name: otp-dialog
description: Compact OTP verification dialog with four digit slots, resend countdown, and success or error feedback.
purpose: Confirms a one-time code from email or SMS in a focused overlay so a signed-in product can finish a sensitive step without leaving the page.
bestFor: step-up verification before a sensitive action
avoidFor: authenticator app pairing with a QR code
full-page login that should stay on a dedicated route
